messages:
anna: Quick sync  we need a short copy pass for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing module. One hero, three rails. Draft by EOD.

tom: I'll write three 1-line hero variants and three supporting bullets each. Keep language engineer-friendly.

jit: Benchmarks: keep to two datapoints (p99 latency, cost delta vs OSS). Use ranges not exact dollars. I'll provide sanitized figures.

design-bot: Suggest layout: hero + small benchmark pill + three equal cards under hero. Primary CTA should be contextual.

tom: Draft microcopy: Hosted: "Start serving with a fast, dev-friendly API." Bullets: "Quick start credits", "Streaming responses", "Transparent quotas"

tom: Dedicated: "Reserved capacity for predictable throughput." Bullets: "SLA-backed uptime", "Autoscale with burst", "Isolated GPU pools"

tom: Private: "Inference behind your network  VPC and on-prem options." Bullets: "Customer-managed keys", "Audit logs", "Enterprise controls"

anna: Benchmark pill copy idea: "p99: ~120200ms (chat)  3060% lower per-token cost vs default OSS stack. Methodology tooltip: 1k concurrent chats, 2k-token context."

jit: I'll sanitize numbers to ranges and percent deltas. No price-per-token publicly.

anna: Inbound form mapping: small orgs -> self-serve; mid (51250) -> SDR; large/compliance -> AE. Keep simple.

design-bot: Will mock the hero personalization toggle "Mode: Hosted / Dedicated / Private" and persist via cookie.

anna: Webinar promo line for hero: "Live demo: choosing the right deployment  see benchmarks and customer configs" with CTA "Register".

jit: I'll send the sanitized benchmark blurb by tomorrow morning and mark legal review for any customer quotes.

tom: Will produce A/B test variants: performance-first vs economics-first CTAs.

anna: Great. Owners: Tom (copy), Jit (benchmarks & routing), Design-bot (mock). Review on Slack tomorrow AM.
